difficulty_reason: Builds the equalizer diagram from the fppf sheaf of infinitesimal lifts; the torsor structures identify the difference delta_1 of the two images of y' in T_x(I) (x)_A B_1; the Cech complex of T_x(I) (x)_A B_i is acyclic by the descent lemma, so an element kills delta_1; acting on y' equalizes the images and the sheaf condition produces the lift over A'; the omitted 1-cocycle computation is mechanism-named bookkeeping.
